summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from RIT (May 2026) building real-time Edge AI and computer vision systems. Deployed YOLO-based perception and TensorRT-optimized inference on NVIDIA Jetson devices, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, C++/CUDA, deep learning, and vision-language model research. Skilled at translating deep-learning CV models from training (TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch) into production edge deployments.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Built and deployed YOLO-based object detection models in production-like settings; optimized inference with TensorRT on NVIDIA Jetson.
Implemented 8-bit quantization pipeline reducing inference latency by ~25% while maintaining >97% accuracy on binary-state classifiers.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Trained PyTorch neural networks for vision-language tasks; worked with vision encoders and attention-based architectures.
Collaborated on text-image embedding model research under agile development practices with weekly sprint reviews.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Contributed to ML model evaluation for embedded systems; wrote C++ data-structure utilities for real-time analytics.
Supported production-scale data pipelines for binary-state monitoring across distributed sensors.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: End-to-end C++ + PyTorch + TensorRT pipeline: speech recognition → command parsing → robotic arm actuation on Jetson Nano.
Achieved real-time (<200ms) response with YOLO-based vision feedback; deployed with CUDA kernel optimizations.
Integrated vision-language reasoning module for dynamic scene understanding (research prototype).

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Implemented YOLOv8-based vehicle and pedestrian detection in simulated urban environments.
Built modular C++ perception pipeline integrating camera inputs, object tracking, and path-planning interfaces.

projects.name: Quantization-Aware Training for Integer-Only Inference
bullets: Developed 8-bit quantization-aware training pipeline in PyTorch, reducing model size by 78% with <2% accuracy loss.
Profiled inference latency on Jetson Orin Nano; benchmarked 1.5× speedup over floating-point baseline.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Optimized memory coalescing and load balancing in custom CUDA kernels; improved throughput by 25% on Jetson devices.
